_doc: Documented leniency of the other decoders, one entry per (decoder, blocktools error code) observed by the fuzz (seed 20261101; the CI job re-measures). An entry matches a mutated case where blocktools abi-decode REJECTED it with that error code (exact; a trailing * matches a numeric width) and that decoder ACCEPTED it. Anything not listed fails the job. These say the other decoder is less strict than docs/ABI-STRICT.md, not that it is wrong.
